snippet.title: We Found What Was Eating the Loot | FEEDSTOCK
snippet.description:
We were supposed to collect the loot. We found something else.

A maintenance drone flies through the house, finds Tally, and gets a little too close.

FEEDSTOCK is a 4-player online co-op horror game where you break into abandoned houses, carry everything you can find, and feed it to something that grows with every meal.

If you play Lethal Company, R.E.P.O., Content Warning or PEAK with your friends, keep an eye on this one.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5154830/FEEDSTOCK/

💬 Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/MRhbPFpuM

Coming 2026.
